objectives.text: Unlock and enter the Main Lab
Reach the emergency exit and escape

hints.lab-entry: There's a keypad on the right wall. The code might be written down somewhere in this room.
hints.main-lab: The symbol diagram on the wall looks important. Find the matching cards.
hints.server-room: The fuse box needs the right sequence. Check the cables.
hints.bio-lab: The bio-switch needs a specific pattern. Study the specimens.
hints.director-office: The safe combination is hidden in this room — look carefully.
hints.security-hub: The security panel needs a sequence. Watch it carefully.
hints.utility-corridor: Check the frequency reader — match the target shown elsewhere.
hints.final-exit: Use everything you've collected. The exit is close.
hints.secret-room: You found it. The hatch code is here somewhere.

catalogue.label: Shadow Exit
catalogue.desc: Find and use the hidden tunnel

catalogue.label: Security Response
catalogue.desc: Caught by security after triggering the alarm

catalogue.label: Time Expired
catalogue.desc: Facility lockdown completes before you escape

escaped.title: ESCAPE SUCCESSFUL
escaped.flawless: Flawless. Not one alarm tripped, not one hint taken. You solved Arcadia like you'd been inside before.
escaped.clean: Clean exit — no alarms, no fumbles. You walk out into the night like you were never here.
escaped.alarm: Security was seconds behind you. You barely cleared the exit before the doors sealed. Close — too close.
escaped.fast: You tore through the lab at speed. The exit door slams behind you before the facility even registers you were inside.
escaped.default: You burst through the exit as the lab goes into full lockdown. Fresh air. Freedom. You made it.

secret-escape.title: SHADOW EXIT
secret-escape.noHints: The maintenance tunnel delivers you to open air. You found the way out that wasn't supposed to exist — without any help. Whatever K started, you finished it.
secret-escape.default: The hidden tunnel leads to daylight. Somewhere out there, K is owed an answer. You have the evidence. The rest is up to you.

time-out.title: TIME EXPIRED
time-out.manyMistakes: You tripped every alarm in the building. The lockdown was already sealed long before the clock hit zero.
time-out.nearExit: You were right there. The exit was in front of you. One more minute and you'd have made it — but the facility doesn't negotiate.
time-out.default: The lockdown sequence completes. Automated doors seal. The ventilation system purges. You are still inside.

alarm-caught.title: SECURITY RESPONSE
alarm-caught.nearEscape: You almost made it. Five more seconds and you'd have cleared the exit. Security was that close.
alarm-caught.default: Red lights. Boots on tile. The security team moves fast. You don't reach the exit in time.
